questions: Should the function handle other punctuation marks besides periods as sentence separators (e.g., exclamation marks, question marks, semicolons)?
Should the function treat numbers as tokens (since CountVectorizer default token pattern includes numbers)?
Should the function convert text to lowercase before tokenization (CountVectorizer default is True)?
Should the function remove stop words (CountVectorizer default is no stop word removal)?
Should the function strip leading/trailing whitespace from sentences after splitting?
What should happen if the input text is an empty string or contains only punctuation/whitespace?
Should the function use a custom token pattern or other CountVectorizer parameters (e.g., max_df, min_df)?
Should the function preserve the order of sentences as they appear in the text in the DataFrame rows?
